name: Audrey
description: Local-first memory firewall and MCP server for AI agents. Audrey provides recall, memory capsules, preflight checks, reflexes, validation, tool-trace learning, contradiction handling, and SQLite/sqlite-vec storage.

rawRecord.description: Local-first memory firewall and MCP server for AI agents. Audrey provides recall, memory capsules, preflight checks, reflexes, validation, tool-trace learning, contradiction handling, and SQLite/sqlite-vec storage.

AUDREY_HOST.description: REST sidecar bind address. Set to 0.0.0.0 only with AUDREY_API_KEY.

AUDREY_AGENT.description: Logical agent identity stamped on writes.

AUDREY_DEBUG.description: Set to 1 to print MCP info logs (server started, warmup completed). Errors always log.

AUDREY_DEVICE.description: Local embedding device (gpu or cpu). Falls back to CPU if GPU init fails.

AUDREY_API_KEY.description: Bearer token required for non-loopback REST traffic.

AUDREY_PROFILE.description: Set to 1 to emit per-stage timings via MCP _meta.diagnostics.

AUDREY_DATA_DIR.description: SQLite memory store path. Use one per tenant or agent identity for isolation.

AUDREY_ONNX_VERBOSE.description: Set to 1 to restore ONNX runtime EP-assignment warnings (suppressed by default).

AUDREY_ALLOW_NO_AUTH.description: Set to 1 to allow non-loopback bind without an API key. Don't.

AUDREY_PROMOTE_ROOTS.description: Colon/semicolon-separated extra roots for audrey promote --yes writes.

AUDREY_DISABLE_WARMUP.description: Set to 1 to skip background embedding warmup at MCP boot.

AUDREY_PRAGMA_DEFAULTS.description: Set to 0 to revert SQLite PRAGMA tuning to better-sqlite3 defaults.

AUDREY_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.description: local, gemini, openai, or mock. Cloud providers require explicit opt-in.

AUDREY_ENABLE_ADMIN_TOOLS.description: Set to 1 to enable export, import, and forget routes/tools. Disabled by default.
